title: Transfer - Litigation Exhibit Binder Assembly
goal: Build a court exhibit binder by selecting specific page ranges from several source PDFs, fixing rotated pages, inserting divider pages, and merging everything into a single ordered appendix PDF.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the pdf skill from redaction to structural document manipulation: page extraction, rotation, synthetic page insertion, and deterministic merging, without depending on any non-PDF capability.
